tips_en: Start with WeMM-Embedding for its broad scope and state-of-the-art results across multimodal tasks, which provides useful context for both other papers. Its two-stage training strategy (large-scale alignment plus curated refinement) shares conceptual DNA with DiffusionOPSD's self-distillation loop, as both convert sparse signals into structured intermediate supervision. AutoSaddler connects thematically through its own iterative optimization framework, though applied to agent harness tuning rather than model training.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读 WeMM-Embedding，它覆盖面广且在多模态任务上达到最先进水平，能为理解另外两篇论文提供有用背景。其两阶段训练策略（大规模对齐 + 精选微调）与 DiffusionOPSD 的自蒸馏循环有概念上的共通之处——两者都将稀疏信号转化为结构化的中间监督。AutoSaddler 通过其迭代优化框架与前两篇论文形成主题呼应，不过它应用于智能体 harness 调优而非模型训练。
